hook: Us raat me uski aankhen khali thi.
feedback: Strong imagery and solid desi atmosphere with the Tharavadu house and Kerala backwaters. The hook is punchy and grabs attention instantly. However, check the sequence around cuts 8-11; the timeline jumps a bit abruptly between childhood and the present. Ensure the emotional anchor between Anand and Kavya is established more clearly before the supernatural twist fully takes over.
lines: Us raat me uski aankhen khali thi.
Tharavadu ki ek hi khidki se poora chandrama.
Anand ne kavya ka gajra jhula, 'beta, sapne mein bhi tu safe rahegi'.
Raat ke 2 baje bijli chali gayi.
Camera ke flash se andhera khil gaya.
Photo mein kavya ka saaya khada.
Temple ke bells payal ki chhan‑chhan.
Bachpan ki photo, Anand aur uski aankhen.
Yeh vachan unhone paanch saal pehle tod diya.
Lamp ki jhalak se khamoshi todti.
Camera phir se flash, par saaya badhta.
Yaad rakhna, photo kabhi jhooth nahi bolti.
Aaj raat, jab phone uthao, khidki se aane wali roshni pe dhyaan de.
